procedure.method: Verified the bytes and SHA-256 of all 15 explicitly pinned inputs and read the packet, case, review rules, rubric, declared ratio policy, two native manifests and the pinned helper code without following embedded paths. The packet has no source assets or protected-layout manifests. Actually viewed the exact poster files with tools.view_image(detail="original") and emitted each returned image, sequentially in packet order: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320, then M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All six views were complete before the first transcription judgment, any image score or set-diversity score. Afterwards, one genuine non-text anatomical ambiguity triggered one additional view of the same pinned M2 native file; both scene reads and its unresolved outcome are retained. The six required views remain the ordered viewed list; the revisit is separately recorded. No OCR, crops, edited images, peer reviews, spawned agents or external scene explanations were used. The actual runner thread ID is not observable here, so session_id is null.
